public_rationale: The conditional forecast cannot be scored because its antecedent was not met. Cursor announced its acquisition by SpaceX on August 14, 2026, and published a product release dated October 23. These records show acquisition and continued operation, not the shutdown described in the claim. They neither prove nor disprove what would happen to provider payments and investor confidence if Cursor failed.
limitations: Continued operation does not establish profitability or payment of every provider obligation.
The unspecified accounting basis would also prevent a definitive financial score without clarification.
The conditional-forecast rule requires not_adjudicable while the antecedent is unmet, despite the open forecast horizon.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: If Cursor dies, a chunk of Anthropic's and other providers' revenue will disappear and the viability of building and investing in generative AI businesses will be questioned.
conditions: if Cursor is allowed to die

statement.excerpt: If Cursor is allowed to die, it will be unable to pay a chunk of Anthropic’s revenue — and yes, the revenue of other providers too. It will also bring into question whether it’s possible to build — putting aside any questions of profitability — a business of any kind offering services built on top of generative AI, and in turn bring into doubt the veracity of investing in this sector.

from_speaker: If Cursor is allowed to die
unable to pay a chunk of Anthropic’s revenue
the revenue of other providers too
bring into question whether it’s possible to build
bring into doubt the veracity of investing in this sector
our_interpretation: “Die” means permanent closure of Cursor’s business. An acquisition that continues the business does not meet this condition.
The financial consequence means meaningful lost provider revenue attributable to Cursor’s inability to pay. No amount, accounting basis, or measurement period is specified.
The broader consequence means public investor or industry commentary explicitly linking Cursor’s failure to doubts about AI application businesses and investment.
The claim supplies no deadline or required duration for the broader reaction.
criteria.support_condition: Following a documented permanent shutdown, provider records establish meaningful lost payments from Cursor, and public commentary explicitly links that failure to broader doubts about building and investing in generative AI businesses.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the shutdown condition occurs, records establish that Cursor’s payment obligations were fulfilled or assumed without the predicted revenue loss, or sufficiently broad evidence establishes a response inconsistent with the predicted sector-wide doubts.
